Not recommended at all

I will 100% be recommending The Veterinary Clinic-New Hall to friends and family,i have a French Bulldog who had a very red weeping eye,due to the Easter Weekend i was unable to find a veterinary practice who could see me at such short notice,however i managed to find The Veterinary Clinic who when i called at around 10:30am made me an appointment at 12:00am,the vet who seen me was so thorough examining my dogs eye and was able to sort me out with the medication needed to treat her eye condition,anyway by the next day her eye has improved so thankyou you to the Vet and Nurse as well as the Receptionist for all your help 100% satisfied.

Later edit: our dog had an accute condition and both doctor Max and the reception staff were absolutely stellar.
Everyone did their absolute best for our Eddie, they kept him as comfortable as possible, they kept us informed, acted promptly and we are seeing results, on the exact timeline the vet described. Flawless service. Couldn't be happier.

Doctor was lovely. She explained everything so well and in great detail. Reception was wonderful too, they helped me with all the info I needed and everyone made such a fuss over my dog. He was at ease and got lots of pets and lots of love
Always a prompt professional service , all the staff are so caring , 100% recommend

I can't recommend this vet clinic enough!
The staff are very kind, patient, and visibly joyful to see and care for pets.
All of the services are usually included in the subscription/monthly payments, so no surprises with upselling like you get with most clinics ("Ooh, we clipped your dog's nails, £15 please" 😂). Really great value for the money you pay! Keep up the fantastic work! ❤️
Very quick and efficient service.  My cat was examined with care, which made the visit less traumati despite the two injections 💉. …

Julie was our initial point of contact and did everything she could to accommodate seeing our Whippet who had suffered an attack from another dog on a Sunday.  We have moved from our previous vet to this practice now. The vet we saw made Misty a priority and the surgery was completed really quickly and Misty was back home just after lunch with review check ups planned. The invoice came out less than the initial estimate too so that is always welcome.
I've recently moved to sutton coldfield i have four rescue cats I've visited with two of my cats very friendly helpful professional staff seating available and parking

Having had a few negative experiences at other vets — and with our dog being a nervous boy at the best of times — it’s fair to say that a year ago he wasn’t the nicest patient. We happened to visit New Hall by chance, and it has completely changed the game for us.

Following their recommendation for social visits, he’s been popping in every month over the past year just to say hello, have a few treats, and enjoy a quick game with his beloved tennis ball. The transformation has been incredible — our once terrified dog now wags his tail and greets the staff instead of cowering in the corner.

Thank you! To everyone at New Hall for taking the time to build his confidence and make him feel safe. The dog who used to snarl and growl out of fear now looks forward to visits, wanting fuss and attention instead. I used to think trips to the vet would always be traumatic for all of us, but thanks to the amazing team at New Hall, that’s no longer the case. For the first time since he was a little puppy he had his injections with no problems, no howling, or having an accident due to fear. He wasn't man handled or dragged out the back to be treated and I didn't leave feeling like the worst dog owner in the world.

They genuinely care, listen to your concerns, and go above and beyond to make sure every dog is comfortable — taking things entirely at their pace. I couldn’t (and wouldn’t) go anywhere else.

I wouldn’t recommend this place.
All they care about is money and it’s sad.
Vet Cofin is amazing, especially with cats, the rest of them as well as the receptionists. Absolutely diabolical!!!

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 5 stars – Exceptional Care for Special Dogs

I can’t praise The Veterinary Clinic on Walmley Road enough. From the moment you arrive, the team welcome you with warmth and genuine care, and it’s clear they truly love the animals they look after.

A very special thank you to Jenny, who is simply outstanding – a true 10 out of 10 in every way. She has been caring for my beautiful dog Skyla, who is an amputee and uses a wheelchair after surviving a traumatic accident. Despite her challenges, Skyla is full of life, and Jenny treated her with such patience, compassion, and respect.

It’s rare to find a vet who truly understands the unique needs of disabled and special-needs dogs, but Jenny went above and beyond. She explained Skyla’s care in detail, answered every question without rushing, and made sure Skyla felt calm and safe throughout her visit. The kindness and empathy she showed meant the world to us.

The clinic itself is clean, organised, and run by a wonderful team who all share the same dedication to animal welfare. If you have a pet with mobility issues, in a wheelchair, or an amputee like Skyla, I cannot recommend this practice highly enough. They provide not just exceptional veterinary care, but also genuine understanding and support for both you and your pet.

Thanks to Jenny, Skyla continues to live her best life with comfort, dignity, and happiness – and for that, we are forever grateful.
Lovely vets, glad I chose here for my new kittens!

We've had a great experience with this practice and couldn't be happier with the care our pets have received. All of the staff are incredibly friendly, compassionate, and consistently go above and beyond to look after the animals in their care.

An experience that really stood out was when our dog needed stitches after a bite. The vet managed to perform the surgery the same day, even though our appointment was later in the afternoon. We were so grateful for the responsiveness and dedication of the team. Special thanks to Lorraine, Jenny, and Zdena, who have all provided exceptional care to our dog recently. They were kind, professional, and took the time to make both us and our dog feel safe and well looked after.

As pet owners, we always feel listened to. The staff makes sure to explain every option and never pressures us into unnecessary treatments, it's clear they care about the wellbeing of the pets more than anything. The clinic itself is clean and welcoming.
Always shocked at the expense. 10 mins with the vet, eye drops and 6 pain killer tabs - £145!

Absolutely awful .. avoid at all costs
Last year my dog went here for a general health check i had noticed a lump on her leg and wanted their opinion on what it was.
On two occasions from two veterinarian’s i was told it was nothing to worry about and to leave it alone.
After 2/3months i made an appointment at another vet practice and on seeing the lump said it needed to be looked into and not to leave it alone at all and tests needed to be done.
Imagine how upset we were to hear it was in fact a cancerous tumour that now because of its position could not be removed and  the only chance of cure was amputation.
Shame on you for your dismissive and wrong opinion which has now possibly cost our very much loved dog her life or a shorter one at best
No compassion care or real interest from them at all …the two individuals should not be in the profession and i intend to find out the names of both and update lets name and shame these so called professionals who pretend they care about our animals
Lovely and friendly, just expensive
Very nice care given  at this vet surgery everyone is so helpful and caring. Wealth of veterinarian knowledge. I would recommend it any day!
Lovely staff..very patient with a nervous dog..highly recommend.

My kitten has been going here since 8 weeks old. She has recently been spade and we pay the 18.99 a month which gives all her flea, worming and vet check ups included as well as her microchipping.  Great peace of mind. Vets are very caring amd knowledgeable.
We have a poorly cat, they were very kind and professional

The people who work there are so friendly and make you feel that your pet is as important to them as they are to you. You are seen at your appointment time and they really pay attention to you and your pet. I would highly recommend this vets

Absolutely shocking first experience from this vet, “Pete” the vet carer has no shame, more interested in going home “in 10 minutes” than doing a professional job and care work! Spent £160 only to return back home with my dog in a worse state than when I took her there!
Look at how “Pete” left my dog.

Ive just had a new puppy, the vet and ladies at reception were all lovely and so helpful and made the process so easy, now my puppy has been microchipped, had his first vaccinations (all with the vets great distraction technique), booked in for his 2nd and i have pet insurance that covers him and made it all so much cheaper, really appreicated and enjoyed our visit today 😀
Very kind, professional, reasonable and welcoming staff, very good with my nervous rescue dog and wouldn’t hesitate to continue using their services.
